title: SAMPLE: Freight delays reported on the Sebha corridor
summary: Hauliers described longer waiting times south of Sebha. This is a sample logistics note, not a road-closure confirmation.
whatHappened: Three sample haulier notes described waiting times of several hours at a checkpoint south of Sebha on 1–2 September 2026. No transport ministry statement was available in the sample pack.
whyItMatters: Southern corridors move fuel, food and humanitarian cargo. Delay reports affect delivery windows even when roads remain formally open.
watchNext: Whether waiting times persist after 4 September 2026, and whether any official traffic instruction is issued.
confidenceRationale: Multiple similar haulier notes, still no official confirmation.
